title: Protocol: exempt flexible_casting from the 'record every bonus action with spend_turn_resource' rule
description: Non-material S1 from Opus review eshyra-cim4.2 of PR #633: protocol.ts ~274 tells the DM to record every bonus action via spend_turn_resource; flexible_casting now spends its own, so calling both refuses the conversion (fails safe). Add the exception to that sentence. Also S2: derive the spent resource from the pack's actionCost instead of hard-coding bonus_action.
